p: Will start at QB against Seattle in place of Purdy.
Jones is a locked-in starter this week, with Shanahan expressing full confidence after a full week of prep.
So everyone's got a ton of confidence in Mac.
Mac Jones stays with the 49ers as Purdy's backup after teams called about him before the deadline.
Purdy's backup is secure, so there is no change at QB.
I'm very glad he's still here.
